messages:
Aisha: Hey team — new 'Winter Wish Tree' in #lobby! Add a paper tag with a wish (fun or practical). I'll snap a pic 🌲✨
Ben: Love it! What counts as a wish? Cookies? A nap room? :joy:
Aisha: Anything lighthearted — ornaments, recipes, book recs, or a small desk plant!
Carla: I'll bring blank tags + markers. Also bringing hot chocolate mix on Thurs :hot_chocolate:
Dylan: Can we add a 'Secret Santa-lite' box to the tree? Small swap, <$10.
Aisha: Yeah, go for it — label 'swap' tags. No pressure.
Emma: If anyone wants to add a 'singalong request' tag, I'll coordinate a quick 20-min choir on Friday 4pm. Casual. :microphone:
Ben: I'm in. Will attempt carols w/ two left feet.
Maya: Ooh can we have a sticky note with recipe swaps? I'll post my grandma's shortbread.
Maya: ```Shortbread: 1C butter, 1/2C sugar, 2C flour. Bake 350F 12-15m.```
Alex: Can someone take a picture after setup? I want to send to remote folks.
Aisha: @Alex @holiday-bot can we livestream a 2-min peek for remote folks during setup?
holiday-bot: Scheduled a 2-min livestream at 15:00 on Thursday. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/holiday-brief
Nathan: Quick poll: does anyone need wheelchair-accessible spot next to tree? I can rearrange tables.
Carla: Good call - yes please move the low table by the ficus.
Ben: Bring marshmallows? I volunteer for the 'marshmallow bar' shift :raised_hands:
Dylan: I made a Spotify playlist 'Redwood Holiday Mix' — drop song recs in thread.
Emma: Santa Baby! :santa:
Maya: Also entering names for postcard-exchange (remote + local). Add your name to the tag 'postcard' on tree.
Aisha: Thanks everyone — I'll put up labels for 'singalong', 'swap', 'postcard', 'recipes', 'general wishes'.
Carla: Setup Thurs 2pm - volunteers? I'm free.
Ben: 2pm fine.
Alex: I'll grab the camera.
holiday-bot: Reminder set: Tree setup Thu 14:00. Ping channel 30m prior.
Aisha: Photo after setup: will share + tag remote folks. Happy almost-holiday y'all :)
